rules.condition: self:lifetime() ~= 0 / owner and owner:dead() == 0 / self.hp < self.max_hp
rules.semantic: Only a summoned elemental (finite lifetime) with a living owner and missing health takes the toll from its summoner; a natural (lifetime 0) or full-health elemental, or one whose owner is gone/dead, takes nothing and burns no lifetime.

arms.observable: defensive: the engine has already killed the summon (living::act owner check)

tests.note: eligible arm: summoned, hurt, owner alive -> toll paid

rules.condition: owner.hp >= owner.max_hp/3 -> pay 1 hp; paid and owner.mp >= 3 -> pay 3 mp; paid == 2 -> heal 1 else lifetime - 1
rules.semantic: A hurt summoned elemental takes 1 HP (if its owner is at or above a third of max health) and then 3 MP from its owner to heal 1 HP per tick; if the owner cannot pay both, the elemental loses one EXTRA tick of lifetime (on top of the engine's per-act lifetime tick) instead -- and an owner who paid the HP but not the MP still loses that HP (classic quirk).

arms.observable: owner hp -1, mp -3; elemental hp +1; lifetime unchanged
owner hp -1 (lost), mp unchanged; elemental lifetime -1
